The plate looks like a dinner plate of about 26 cm. It holds a roll, a roast chicken portion, and a few cucumber slices.

The roll is about 20 cm long, which makes it a sub or hoagie-style roll. I estimate it at about 85 g, or roughly 230 kcal.

The chicken looks like half a rotisserie chicken breast with the wing, plus a small piece that may be a thigh or drumstick. I estimate about 250 g, but part of that is bone. Meat with skin comes to about 200 kcal per 100 g of edible portion, so roughly 150 g of edible meat gives about 300 kcal. The skin adds some more, so I put the chicken at about 350 kcal.

The cucumber is negligible, about 30 g and 5 kcal.

Total mass is about 85 + 250 + 30 = 365 g. Total energy is about 230 + 350 + 5 = 585 kcal, which I round to about 580.
